sections.h2: Four Acts replaced laws aged 67 to 169 years in five months

sections.means: Four Acts were passed between March and August 2025, retiring laws that were up to 169 years old.

sections.h2: Foreign-flagged ships carry about 95% of India's own overseas trade

chart.title: Indian-flagged ships carry only about 5% of India's overseas trade
chart.sub: Share of India's overseas trade, by ship flag, %.
chart.source: DG Shipping data as reported in trade press; ICRA March 2025 note.

sections.means: The new Acts leave this split in place, with about 5% of cargo on Indian-flagged ships.
sections.todo: Track the fleet and freight figures over the coming years to see whether Indian ships gain cargo share.

sections.h2: Flying the Indian flag costs 16–20% more, which the new Acts do not change

chart.title: Operating under the Indian flag costs an estimated 16–20% more
chart.sub: Extra cost of operating a ship under the Indian flag vs. a foreign flag, %.
chart.source: DG Shipping data as reported in trade press; ICRA March 2025 note.

sections.means: The post estimates the flag cost gap at 16–20%, the main reason shipowners avoid the Indian flag.
sections.todo: Measure whether the $20 billion roadmap and the 300-vessel re-flagging target narrow that gap.
